queries.query: Official documentation only: Composer lockfile installs exact versions; in-toto Statement subjects and digests; SLSA verification of artifact provenance. Provide primary links and explain the limitations for consumer acceptance.

content.text:
"Topic","Official primary link","What it establishes"
"Composer lockfiles","Composer: Basic usage","composer update resolves dependencies and writes their exact versions into composer.lock; with that file present, composer install uses the exact locked versions rather than resolving anew."
"in-toto Statement v1","in-toto: Statement layer specification","The Statement binds a predicate—such as provenance or a scan result—to one or more artifact subjects. Each subject must contain a digest."
"SLSA provenance verification","SLSA: Verifying artifacts, v1.0","A verifier should validate the signature, ensure the Statement subject matches the artifact digest, validate the provenance type, establish a trusted builder, and compare provenance to package-specific expectations."
